hook.say: This morning I covered Uber giving ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees after a 1,000-person pilot. Then I went back in to check the numbers around it.

findings.label: MODEL COST
findings.headline: Per million output tokens on Work's default model
findings.detail: GPT-6.1 Sol is the default in ChatGPT Work. Astra, the top model, charges $50 for the same output.

bars.label: GPT-6.1 Sol, $ per M output tokens
GPT-6 Astra, $ per M output tokens

findings.evidence: GPT-6.1 Sol costs $2/$10 per million tokens with cached input cut to $0.10.
findings.say: First, the default model, GPT-6.1 Sol, charges ten dollars per million output tokens. Astra charges fifty, so the cost per task drops sharply.

findings.label: SEAT PRICE
findings.headline: Reported monthly Enterprise seat, with no list price
findings.detail: OpenAI does not publish Enterprise pricing. Business seats list at $20 on annual billing.

bars.label: ChatGPT Business, $ per seat per month
ChatGPT Enterprise reported typical, $ per seat per month

findings.evidence: Widely reported 2026 figures cluster around $60 per user per month, a typical range of $45 to $75, and a 150-seat minimum.
findings.say: Second, Enterprise seats have no list price, but buyers report around sixty dollars a month, against twenty for Business.

findings.label: REACTIONS
findings.headline: Of developer reactions to the rollout are skeptical
findings.detail: Only 15% were positive and 45% mixed. Doubts focus on permissions, data access and long-term adoption.
findings.say: Third, early developer reactions to the rollout are split: forty percent skeptical, forty-five mixed, fifteen positive.

take.headline: Cost is easy. Impact is the hard part.
take.say: My take: the model cost is the small part. Pay for seats and tokens, then measure which workflows actually changed.

caption:
This morning: Uber is giving ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees, up from a 1,000-person pilot. No results have been reported yet.

The deep dive: the default model costs $10 per million output tokens against $50 for Astra. Enterprise seats are reportedly around $60 a month, with no list price. And 40% of developer reactions are skeptical.

My take: the model cost is the small part. Measure which workflows actually changed.

Comment PROJECT and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.
